name: Lost in the woods
source:
You enter a mysterious forest and encounter a strange boy while trying to leave. 

Will you be able to find your way out?

[from [url=https://shadoli.itch.io/lost-in-the-woods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你进入了一个神秘的森林，并在试图离开时遇到了一个奇怪的男孩。

你能找到出路吗？
